This [[blue]] '''gas giant''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|UR-2212-GR system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] had an [[Frozen moon|icy moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] it that was home to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial research facility|research facility]].
